# Mermaid terminal renderer provenance

`crates/pi-tui/src/mermaid.rs` derives from `crates/codegen/xai-grok-markdown/src/mermaid.rs` in xai-org/grok-build commit `c68e39f60462f28d9be5e683d9cbe2c57b1a5027`. Original SHA-256: `1dc29bca611bedf023b9ebaca76a3a1b7ab8d1208f95c2b58b1a5edf854f9c15`.

Licensed under Apache-2.0; see [license](grok-mermaid-LICENSE). The adaptation replaces ratatui types with local semantic spans and removes upstream internal tests. Further differences are identified in the renderer tests.
